kind: eight rendered image views, not a 3D mesh
basis: User-supplied red Proton Saga photo/render references; additional viewpoints generated using image generation.
runtime_decode: ARGB_8888, inSampleSize=2, maximum retained atlas 2 MiB
notes: Generated viewpoints may differ in trim/reflections from the supplied car.
Frames are changed on touch; no autoplay, WebView or 3D renderer is used for image angles.
